mostWorthwhile.text: Building the retina with its outgoing nerve was most worthwhile: the picture connected the new names to parts and showed how signals leave the light-sensitive lining.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the completed eye to the body was straightforward, but the final result stopped at showing nerves toward the brain rather than showing how the leaf becomes a sight.

surprise.text: The light-sensitive lining and its gathered nerve fibres have distinct names: retina and optic nerve.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The pictures and goals made the pairings understandable, although they did not explain in detail how light becomes a nerve signal.

continue.text: I would probably continue: putting the eye together was clear and satisfying, and I would be curious to see how another sense works.
